In detail

Coverciano is a residential area near the national football training centre and Campo di Marte stadium. A city councillor publicly called for 'concrete interventions' on security in Coverciano together with adjacent Campo di Marte, but no specific documented incidents (assaults, break-ins) distinct from the general Campo di Marte pattern were found for Coverciano itself, so this is treated as a mild, secondary concern rather than a confirmed hotspot. Sources checked: Comune di Firenze press release, Italia Viva councillor statement on Coverciano/Campo di Marte security.

Frequently asked questions

Is Coverciano safe?

Wandroz currently rates Coverciano in Florence as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Florence publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Coverciano safe at night?

At night, Coverciano is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Florence. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Coverciano a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Coverciano's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Florence) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Coverciano?

Not an official government crime feed — Coverciano's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
